Name: Aurora Veil
Components: V, S, M (a handful of water)
Description: A protective magical force surrounds you, manifesting as a freezing cold veil that protects you and your gear. You gain 5 temporary hit points for the duration, and until the spell ends you are resistant to cold damage. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, the creature takes 5 cold damage.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, both the temporary hit points and the cold damage increase by 5 for each slot level above 1st.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
